svg.text: OPEN ROBSTRIDE HUMANOID - ELECTRICAL CONNECTION SCHEME (2026-07-17)
Hands-on-WEHO revision · negatives omitted: all return to PDU - / battery - (WEHO non-isolated)
interim: swap at XT90-S, never both
Motor drops: RS03/RS04 = AMASS XT30UW-F power + JST GH1.25 CAN · RS06/RS00/RS05 = Seeed BCCA4011 XT30 (2+2) combined power+CAN lead.
2 · SAFETY / POWER-UP CHAIN (24 V, pure hardware - SEQ-PWR-01 wiring drawing)
from 24 V rail through the MINI 2 A safety fuse (zone 1)
• timer -> LEV100 closes on a charged bus
• e-stop / 24 V loss -> every coil drops,
motor bus dead; Thor stays alive and logs
• Thor gates motor enable via RobStride
VBUS telemetry - it is NOT in the chain
Space: K1 latch 26.5 x 32 x 33.5 mm · timer+socket ~25 x 35 x 80 mm (or laid flat) · START/E-STOP on outer shell, Ø22 panel holes.
J47 harness: pinout to verify on the kit (qty0 row)
RealSense D436 head camera - USB 3 direct, keep off the hub
Phidgets MOT0110 pelvis IMU - CBL4011 280 mm
24 V from the 15 A hand fuse (zone 1), routed in the arm trunks
per hand: one GX12 5-pin plug = 1 GND · 2 VCC 24 V · 3 A+ · 4 B- · 5 GND (RH56 manual)
RS485 115200 bps 8N1 · HAND_ID left=1 right=2 · manuals in hands/
USB sound card · mic on board
USB-C debug: recovery/flash only - keep free.
CAN: Belden 9841NH (LSZH) shielded pair · bus topology, short stubs · exactly two 120 ohm terminations per bus (10 total) · CAN-ID/connector map = HAR-MAP-01 · set CAN_TIMEOUT != 0 on every actuator.
